more.def: Worth a lot of money, or very important and useful.
more.example: Her advice was valuable because it helped me solve the problem.

easy.def: To go away so no one can see it.
easy.example: The magician made the coin vanish.

more.example: The deer vanished into the forest before I could take a picture.

easy.example: My grandma lives in a village.

more.def: A small group of houses and buildings, smaller than a town.
more.example: The village had one school, one shop, and a tiny post office.

easy.def: A mountain that can shoot out hot melted rock.
easy.example: The volcano had smoke on top.

more.def: A mountain with an opening where melted rock, ash, and gas can burst out.
more.example: When the volcano erupted, lava flowed down its sides.
